  • Be located in San Francisco, CA or New York City, NY and have the ability to commute to the office in a hybrid setting.

  • Have 3-5 years of sales experience, with at least 2+ years of management/leadership experience

  • Offer experience in B2B SaaS sales and sales management

  • Have experience prospecting into various market segments and personas

  • Have stellar problem-solving abilities, thrive working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and enjoy the challenge of making a large impact early on in a start-up environment

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software, the intellectual curiosity to want to learn about the world of governance, risk and compliance, and to build great relationships with highly technical prospects who are willing to rethink the paradigm in how security is achieved, and to enhance and evolve their own security programs

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Vanta for Government team, you'll set the technical foundation for Vanta's expansion into the public sector: designing the systems, patterns, and architecture that will power compliance programs from the ground up for government vendors and agencies.

The Vanta for Government team is building and evolving Vanta's AI-powered platform for government vendors, federal agencies, and State, Local, and Education (SLED) organizations. Our mission is to make government compliance not easy, but easier: helping organizations automate the heavy lifting across complex frameworks like FedRAMP, CMMC, and NIST, strengthen their security posture, and support mission-critical work with greater confidence.

You’ll work directly alongside early design partners to shape new capabilities in real time. As the most senior engineer on the team, you'll be the technical anchor through a critical build phase — making the architectural decisions, establishing engineering patterns, and driving the multi-quarter initiatives that will define how Vanta serves government customers at scale.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

What you'll do as a Staff Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Own the technical strategy and architecture for Vanta's government product line, designing systems that adapt Vanta's core compliance platform to meet the demands of federal agencies, government vendors, and SLED organizations

  • Lead the design and build of net-new product capabilities — including core compliance workflow features that don't yet exist in Vanta's product today — working alongside early design partners to validate and iterate as requirements evolve

  • Define reusable abstractions and platform patterns that prevent technical debt as the team scales from its first government customers to a broader portfolio of agencies and vendors

  • Partner with adjacent engineering teams on shared infrastructure and tagging systems that underpin government-specific compliance workflows, building on existing platform investments rather than starting from scratch

  • Drive multi-quarter technical initiatives across engineering, product, and go-to-market, translating ambiguous early-stage requirements into durable, scalable solutions

  • Raise the technical bar for a team of mid-level and senior engineers through mentorship, code review, engineering practice-setting, and high-quality technical decision-making

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

  • Strong systems thinking and platform architecture skills: you design for reuse, scalability, and long-term maintainability, and naturally think in terms of abstractions and patterns

  • Experience in highly regulated industries such as fintech or healthcare; FedRAMP or government domain experience is a plus, but not required

  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, 0→1 environments where requirements evolve as you learn from customers and technical decisions carry real business consequences

  • A strong product mindset: you understand that shipping matters, can prioritize against real deadlines, and balance technical rigor with delivery velocity

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across engineering and bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proven ability to mentor and develop engineers, with a track record of raising team-wide technical quality and building strong engineering culture

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Work Authorization Requirements:

  • You must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

[US] What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Strategic Channel Manager focusing on our VARs partnerships for the EMEA region, you’ll manage a book of Vanta’s strategic channel partnerships, focused on building and scaling our business with major resellers in the security and compliance ecosystem.

This role sits within Vanta’s Partnerships team, where you will have a direct role in bringing Vanta’s vision of securing every technology company. You will help us ensure that our partners always receive quality guidance and enablement as they go-to-market with Vanta.

What you’ll do as a Senior Strategic Channel Manager at Vanta:

  • Develop strong executive relationships across key VAR partners, acting as a strategic thought partner.

  • Build direct relationships with individual VAR sellers to drive rep-level engagement, education, and deal collaboration.

  • Execute Vanta’s go-to-market and enablement playbooks with strategic resellers to ensure consistent pipeline generation and resale execution.

  • Launch and execute joint account mapping strategies to identify overlaps and drive prioritized co-selling motions with Vanta AEs and SDRs.

  • Facilitate co-selling between your partners and our AE team to drive net-new ARR.

  • Enable and train key team members on how working with Vanta will benefit them as a partner

  • Proactively share partner insights, GTM feedback, and competitive intel to help evolve Vanta’s channel strategy.

  • Manage your book effectively, providing regular updates on pipeline generation progress and pacing.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 6+ years of experience in channel sales, strategic partnerships, or business development

  • Proven success working for or with large value-added resellers (e.g., CDW, SHI, Guidepoint, Optiv) in the security or compliance space

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment with a strong bias toward action

  • Deep understanding of reseller sales cycles, incentive models, and co-sell motions

  • Excellent cross-functional team player that can execute and can contribute to strategy

  • Ability to travel as needed for partner events and conferences

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We're scaling our Early Stage Sales team with customer-focused Account Executives who will take ownership of their entire sales cycle and distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

Vanta is growing quickly, we're profitable, and we're continually outpacing our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS scores. Our Sales team is leading the charge in exceeding our revenue goals and growing our market share as the industry leader in compliance and security.

 

If this sounds like you, and you're excited to join a growing sales team, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as a Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on expediting deals within a 30-day timeframe.

  • Turn our inbound demand into closed-new business and happy Vanta customers.

  • Manage our sales pipeline, improving and maturing our sales process and playbook.

  • Define and communicate the specific benefits of Vanta appropriate for each customer, including making sales materials and demos.

  • Collect insights from prospects for our product development process.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role 2+ years, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB with a focus on short deal cycles.

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

What you can expect as a Vanta'n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We're looking for a highly skilled People Systems Administrator to drive the design, configuration, and optimization of Workday across Vanta, with deep functional ownership of the Payroll, Benefits, and/or Absence module(s).

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, People Systems, you'll act as a trusted consultant and system expert, partnering with functional leaders across People, Payroll, Finance, IT, and Legal to identify opportunities, implement advanced solutions, and improve the employee experience. You'll shape the future of our Workday ecosystem by leading complex configurations, driving process improvement, and making sure the system evolves ahead of the business rather than behind it.

What you’ll do as a People Systems Administrator, Workday at Vanta:

  • Own the design and configuration of the Workday platform

    • Lead the design and implementation of configurations across Workday modules (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking) including business processes and security groups along with condition rules and calculated fields.

    • Serve as the primary technical expert for Workday enhancements, partnering with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate ambiguous business problems into scalable system solutions.

    • Build the administration frameworks and standards the team runs on: security role design, tenant and environment management, change control, testing protocols, and documentation.

    • Design reusable, scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes, so the same problem doesn't return in a different shape

    • Own change management for system changes. Plan and deliver stakeholder communications, training, and enablement so changes land with adoption rather than confusion, and measure whether they actually stuck.

  • Drive continuous improvement

    • Proactively analyze Workday processes, integrations, and user interfaces to surface inefficiencies and optimize business processes as needs evolve.

    • Stay ahead of the Workday roadmap and release cycles — review release notes, assess feature impact, run regression testing, turn new functionality into concrete improvements and own release communication and prioritization across stakeholders.

    • Identify where the biggest manual lift sits across People Ops and proactively solve it, rather than waiting for the request.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years in HRIS/People Systems, including significant hands-on Workday configuration and administration.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of the following Workday modules: Payroll, Benefits, or Absence, with working knowledge of the other two and how they interact. Workday certification preferred.

  • Strong command of the Workday business process framework, security configuration, condition rules, and calculated fields.

  • Proven experience owning complex systems initiatives end to end — not just executing assigned configuration tasks.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; effective working independently and collaboratively across teams.

  • A track record of handling confidential employee data with care and designing systems that meet audit and compliance requirements.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. Vanta's Product Marketing team sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. We define positioning and narrative for Vanta's platform, translate roadmap into go-to-market motions across big launch moments and releases, and make sure the field can sell what Product is building; with research, storytelling, and cross-functional partnership as the core of how we work.

About the role

AI is one of Vanta's most strategic bets, and it needs a dedicated owner. This PMM will be focused on bringing the AI roadmap to market in close partnership with EPD. You'll own the narrative, messaging, and positioning for Vanta’s AI story end-to-end, and be the connective tissue between what Engineering and Product are building and how the market, field, and customers understand it.

You're expected to shape our AI story and define Vanta as a leader in the space, which means you’re fast-moving and nimble, have enough technical fluency to have a real point of view in roadmap conversations with EPD (including getting hands-on and testing the product yourself), paired with the storytelling and creativity to bring a unique, differentiated story to market.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the AI pillar narrative and roadmap end to end

  • Own the AI pillar narrative at key events like VantaCon, including keynote support, breakout sessions, and customer testimonials

  • Ensure a cohesive AI narrative across pillars so AI messaging holds together whether it's showing up in Compliance, Risk, or Proof contexts

  • Partner directly with EPD to understand what's being built, influence roadmap sequencing from a market/customer lens, and translate technical capability into external-ready narrative

  • Develop and maintain AI messaging and positioning that flexes across audiences (field, analysts, press, customers)

  • Drive field enablement for AI, arming Sales and CS with the story, objection handling, and proof points they need

  • Plan and execute AI product launches, from planning through post-launch measurement

  • Represent the AI narrative in customer-facing and market-facing moments (analyst briefings, customer advisory conversations, press as needed)

How to be successful in this role:

  • Core PMM experience

    • 7+ years in product marketing, ideally with ownership of a full pillar or product line rather than a support function

    • Track record of building narrative and positioning from scratch, not just executing an existing playbook

    • Experience partnering directly with Product/Engineering leadership

    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Plan and execute large product launches (including partnership with comms to align on product narrative), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

    • Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s security products, including messaging, positioning, launch planning, GTM enablement content (sales, customer success), and customer adoption

    • Strong written and verbal storytelling, comfortable writing for a keynote stage as well as a sales deck

    • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

    Technical / AI fluency

    • Working understanding of how modern AI products are built, enough to ask sharp questions in an EPD roadmap review and push back credibly

    • Familiarity with the current AI/LLM landscape (model capabilities, common architecture patterns, where the industry conversation is headed) so positioning reflects real technical nuance rather than surface-level buzzwords

    • Comfort translating technical capability and constraints into narrative that's accurate and compelling without over-claiming what the product does

    • Prior experience marketing an AI-native or AI-adjacent product is a strong plus

    • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

    Bonus points

    • Experience with security or technical products

    • Experience owning a keynote-level narrative for a company event

    • Background that spans both technical and brand/narrative work (e.g., came from a technical PM, solutions engineering, or technical writing background before moving into PMM)

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As the Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how every team builds Vanta's interface. Your mission is to build the horizontal tooling that lets product, engineering, and design teams create consistent, high-quality user experiences faster, so they can spend more of their time on their customers. To be successful, you’ll need to have a high level of product taste and be able to set and hold the line for high quality and easy to use products. All while working closely with your engineering and design manager partners.

You'll be part of Vanta's Platform organization, which builds the foundational primitives and craft layer the rest of the product is built on. This is the first dedicated Design Systems PM role at Vanta, so you'll help shape the function itself, not just the roadmap. It's a high-autonomy, highly cross-functional role at the center of how Vanta looks, feels, and scales.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta:

  • Own the vision and roadmap for the frontend, spanning the design system and the front-end platform, and ladder durable platform investments to company initiatives so design and engineering can focus on customers.

  • Evolve our design system from a broad component library into smaller, composable building blocks with consistent APIs, including making components first-class for AI and LLM-driven experiences.

  • Drive accessibility and internationalization programs to their committed milestones, including global-scale localization and meeting accessibility standards.

  • Partner with our AI team to enable the agentic patterns product teams need to build the next generation of Vanta experiences.

  • Run go-to-market and adoption for design-system changes, and lead ongoing quality and "paper cuts" triage as the craft team for the entire product.

  • Partner closely with your engineering and design leads as a triad, continuously prioritizing the highest-impact work across a wide surface area.

  • Look 12 to 18 months ahead at how the design system and front-end platform scale with Vanta, including AI-native use.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 4-8+ years of product management experience, with real ownership of a design system, frontend platform, or developer and design experience that served many teams.

  • Bring craft and taste at scale. You have a clear point of view on quality, you can scale it across many teams, and you earn craft credibility with senior design and product leaders.

  • Have a builder's mindset. You're not an engineer, but you're hands-on: you spin up prototypes and demos and build with the same component building blocks that your team ships.

  • Collaborate horizontally and build trust. You serve every product team as an internal platform, build consensus across the company, and you're the partner other teams are glad to see at their door.

  • Think in systems. You reason about how components, tokens, patterns, and front-end infrastructure fit together and cascade across every product surface.

  • Tell the story. You translate why front-end and design-system investment matters into clear business value for leadership and cross-functional partners.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you’ll be responsible for laying the foundation for a best-in-class analytics function. You’ll partner closely with our data science team and business stakeholders to ensure that our analytics stack and processes meet the business needs today with an eye towards the future.

What you’ll do as an Senior Analytics Engineer at Vanta:

  • Design and implement complex data models to enable dashboards, self-serve analytics, and data science teams.

  • Write highly tuned, scalable SQL queries running over large-scale, heterogeneous data warehouses.

  • Enable AI tooling with semantic layers and observability, guiding analytics functions on best practices.

  • Manage and improve data infrastructure needed to drive data-driven decision-making solutions.

  • Help develop front end applications to expose analytical data sets enterprise wide

  • Work with the Product and Corporate Engineering system teams to structure source systems for reporting consumption across the enterprise.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have at least four years of experience working with data and two years of experience in Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Have experience with common analytics tooling (e.g. dbt is a must, Stitch/Fivetran, Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, Airflow, Dagster, Looker/Mode/Sigma).

  • Bring a system-oriented and software engineering mindset to the Analytics Engineering practice. We’re looking to build frameworks that manage data, and minimize bespoke queries.

  • Deep knowledge of crafting dimensional and fact models in modern data fashion.

  • Have a passion for enabling the developer experience of data, and being obsessed with giving data super powers across the company.

  • Desire to lead the industry in security, anonymization, and compliance management when it comes to data warehousing.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Regional Channel Manager on Vanta's Channel & Alliances team, you'll be embedded in the mid-market sales motion — working shoulder-to-shoulder with sales managers and account executives to drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across the segment.

This is a field execution role. You'll use the partner ecosystem as a multiplier on direct sales coverage, co-selling with regional resellers, VARs, and MSPs to open doors, accelerate deals, and expand Vanta's presence in the market. You won't be managing partner relationships from a distance — you'll be in the field, in the forecast, and in the room.

What you’ll do as a Channel Manager at Vanta:

  • Partner with sales managers and AEs to identify and pursue named accounts through channel partners, dividing and conquering coverage across your segment

  • Facilitate account mapping sessions with regional partner sales teams, turning relationships into pipeline

  • Co-sell with partner reps to advance and close partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals

  • Enable regional and tier-2 partners to go to market with Vanta effectively — product positioning, competitive context, and deal support

  • Maintain clean, accurate pipeline data in Salesforce — partner attribution, opportunity staging, and forecast hygiene are core to this role

  • Coordinate closely with Partner Account Managers at deal close to ensure smooth customer handoffs

  • Participate in weekly sales pod syncs and contribute to the FLM's forecast with current partner pipeline data

How to be successful in this role:

  • 4+ years of channel or partner experience in software or SaaS

  • Proven ability to co-sell alongside direct sales teams — you know how to work with sales managers and AEs, not just around them

  • Experience with resellers, VARs, and/or MSPs

  • Understanding of the IT channel ecosystem and how partners sell and serve customers

  • Salesforce proficiency and a genuine commitment to data hygiene and attribution accuracy

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you work well with sales, marketing, and operations

  • Experience with Crossbeam or similar partner ecosystem intelligence tools

  • Background in GRC, compliance, or security SaaS

  • Experience operating within a structured, play-based GTM motion

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Healthcare stipend towards health insurance for you and your dependents

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • 20 days of Annual Leave per year

  • 9 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Corporate Engineering team is the infrastructure layer that keeps 1,500+ people connected, secure, and moving fast. This role leads the shift from a reactive support function to a platform function the whole company relies on.

Corporate Engineering owns the systems, tooling, and access infrastructure Vanta runs on. From identity and device management to AI tooling infrastructure and ITSM, CE makes sure Vanta's people have the right access, the right tools, and the right guardrails on day one and every day after.

CE is at an inflection point. The company has scaled quickly, AI tooling is live company-wide, and the team is ready for a leader who sets technical direction, establishes clear ownership, and builds the leadership layer beneath them.

As Sr. Manager, Systems Engineering, you will lead a team of experienced engineers, own several of the company's highest-priority platform initiatives, and make CE a function the rest of Vanta builds on rather than routes around.

What you’ll do as a Senior Manager, Systems Engineering at Vanta:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of systems engineers and a tech lead. Set clear expectations, hold a high bar, and develop the people who build Vanta's most critical internal systems.

  • Own joiner, mover, and leaver automation end to end in Okta Workflows, so access is correct on day one, follows people through role changes, and closes completely on departure, including API keys and service credentials.

  • Build and own device assurance across macOS and Windows, defining OS, browser, and device-state policy ahead of enforcement rather than in response to it.

  • Rationalize the ITSM estate so self-service works, engineers spend their time on platform work instead of tool administration, and partner teams have a system they trust.

  • Make Corporate Engineering a governed step in SaaS procurement, with SSO enforced, access reviewed, and no tools discovered months after they went live.

  • Own the identity, access, and connector infrastructure behind Vanta's company-wide AI stack, including MCP servers and the Vercel platform, in close partnership with our AI and Data teams.

  • Build the visibility layer that shows how work enters the team and where capacity goes, so priorities are set with data and tradeoffs are legible to partners.

  • Partner with Security, GRC, Finance, and Engineering to enable rather than gate, building guardrails that make self-service safe instead of controls that slow the company down.

How to be successful in this role:

  • A track record of raising the bar on an inherited team, holding it through sustained one-on-one coaching, and staying steady when the results take more than a quarter to show.

  • Real appetite for inherited complexity, whether that is an orphaned endpoint program, an unfinished migration, or an over-engineered workflow. Interest in untangling it, not just tolerance for it.

  • An enablement-first instinct. Your default question is how to make something safe to self-serve, not how to control it.

  • Enough technical depth to evaluate estimates honestly and tell the difference between genuine risk and reported progress.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI in enterprise tooling, including deploying or governing AI-assisted automation in platforms such as Okta, Intune, Jamf, Atlassian, or GitHub.

  • Experience spanning identity, endpoint, ITSM, and procurement, or deep expertise in most of them with a track record of expanding scope.

  • Comfort operating through influence. Several levers this role depends on, including security policy, procurement, and AI strategy, sit in partner organizations.

  • 8+ years in IT or systems engineering, including 3+ years managing and developing engineers, ideally at a company that scaled through a significant headcount inflection.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Corporate Engineering team is the infrastructure layer that keeps 1,500+ people connected, secure, and moving fast. AI is now central to how that happens, and this role leads the team that owns the backbone underneath it.

Corporate Engineering owns the shared AI platform for Vanta's internal systems: identity and access for AI tools, cost visibility and controls, sanctioned tooling and guardrails, and the enablement that helps people use those tools well. We do not own product AI, which stays with Engineering, and we do not replace the AI work happening inside individual departments. We build the engineering layer that makes all of it safer, cheaper, and better supported.

The company has moved fast. AI assistant use is widespread across every function, MCP infrastructure is live and self-serve company-wide, internal apps ship on a hosted platform, and AI spend has grown to the point where attribution and guardrails genuinely matter. What does not exist yet is a single owner for that platform layer. That is this role.

As Sr. Manager, AI Engineering, you will lead a small, senior team, write the charter for what Corporate Engineering owns versus enables, and build the platform that lets the rest of Vanta adopt AI quickly without accumulating cost, risk, or duplication.

What you’ll do as a Senior Manager, AI Corporate Engineering at Vanta:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a senior team spanning platform engineering and technical program management. Set clear direction, hold a high bar, and give the team explicit permission to push back with data.

  • Own the AI access layer end to end: identity and authentication for AI tools, connector and integration allowlisting, tiered permissions by function, and guardrails that make adoption safe by default rather than safe by exception.

  • Own AI cost engineering. Build attribution down to team and individual, right-size model selection to actual need, make agent and automation spend traceable, and set budget thresholds and alerting in partnership with Finance.

  • Own the MCP layer for internal tools end to end, including commissioning, decommissioning, governance, and the downstream impact assessment that has to happen before a migration ships rather than after it breaks.

  • Own the paved path for internal applications: a golden-path deployment pattern, sensible defaults including private-by-default, lifecycle and decommissioning policy so unused apps retire themselves, and a build-versus-buy framework that keeps people from rebuilding tools we already own.

  • Build the enablement layer that turns adoption into impact: a skills and agent registry that cuts duplication, an evaluation framework for internal AI usage, and technical enablement on sanctioned tools that goes beyond provisioning access.

  • Write and hold the charter. Define what Corporate Engineering owns, what it enables, and how work enters the team, then convene the cross-functional forum that keeps departmental AI efforts coordinated rather than duplicated.

  • Partner across Engineering, GRC, Security, Data, Finance, and People. Several of the levers this role depends on sit in those organizations, so the job is to coordinate and influence rather than override.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Experience standing up an internal AI or developer platform function rather than inheriting a mature one. You have written the charter, defined intake, and built the roadmap from a blank page.

  • The ability to hold scope. You can take a commitment that was made without scoping or resourcing, land a bounded first version, and decline the rest without it reading as abdication.

  • Fluency in AI cost engineering: usage attribution, model right-sizing, token economics, agent cost traceability, and the difference between a hard limit and a useful guardrail.

  • An enablement-first instinct. Your default question is how to make something safe to self-serve. When you do have to decline access, you always explain why and offer an alternative path to the same visibility.

The team owns top-of-funnel strategy and operations for the Upmarket Sales organization, supporting both AEs and SDRs. We shape and operate how leads and accounts are deployed across the field through lead routing and management, AE account pairing, territory management, and account assignment strategy.

This role sits at the center of how our Upmarket Sales organization goes to market and creates pipeline. You’ll own both the day-to-day operations and the evolution of our Top-of-Funnel processes—working hands-on in the details while shaping the strategy for how we deploy AEs and SDRs. Your work will ensure the right coverage, processes, and workflows are in place to improve pipeline generation, seller productivity, and the overall efficiency of our GTM motion.

What you’ll do as a Senior GTM Strategy & Operations Manager at Vanta:

  • Own the day-to-day execution of Top-of-Funnel operations, including responding to field requests and managing the processes, data, systems, and business logic underlying lead-to-account, territory, and AE coverage decisions. This is a hands-on role that balances ongoing operational needs with larger strategic initiatives and process improvements.

  • Own territory strategy and ongoing territory management, ensuring AEs and SDRs have high-quality, balanced coverage and identifying opportunities to improve how accounts and selling capacity are deployed.

  • Design and optimize AE coverage and account pairing strategies to improve how our sellers work together to generate and progress pipeline.

  • Identify and lead Top-of-Funnel initiatives that improve pipeline coverage, territory quality, seller productivity, and GTM efficiency.

  • Dig into data, systems, processes, and field feedback to identify root causes of GTM challenges and develop a point of view on what we should do differently.

  • Lead initiatives end-to-end—from problem definition and analysis through recommendation, stakeholder alignment, implementation, and measurement of results.

  • Partner closely with AEs, SDRs, and Sales leadership to understand field needs and translate them into scalable improvements across workflows, processes, tooling, territories, and accountability.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing Operations, GTM Systems, Analytics, and other GTM teams to design and operationalize solutions that work across the broader GTM ecosystem.

  • Serve as a trusted SME for Upmarket lead-to-account and Top-of-Funnel operations, bringing a strong point of view while continuously evolving our operating model as the business scales.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related function, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • Deep experience with Top-of-Funnel and lead-to-account operations, including areas such as lead routing, account assignment, territory management, seller coverage, and AE operating models.

  • An investigative mindset with a demonstrated ability to dig beneath surface-level symptoms, connect insights across data, systems, processes, and field feedback, and identify the root cause of complex GTM problems.

  • A hands-on operating style. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves, getting into the weeds, and doing the detailed work required to turn a strategy or recommendation into something that works in practice.

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to understand complex GTM mechanics while anticipating dependencies, edge cases, and downstream impacts.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to combine quantitative and qualitative insights, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop a clear point of view even when there isn’t an obvious answer.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable business impact.

  • Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with everyone from AEs and SDRs in the field to Sales leadership and partners across GTM.

  • A business-partner mindset: you listen closely to stakeholders and understand their needs while bringing your own expertise, judgment, and willingness to respectfully challenge the proposed solution when there is a better path forward.

  • Ability to move fluidly between strategic thinking and detailed execution—helping shape where we should go while being equally comfortable building the processes required to get there.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing or related field.

As Vanta's Internal Communications Director, you'll help set the internal beat of the company making sure every team member understands the messages that matter, while also defining how we communicate with each other as we scale

The People team builds the systems, culture, and experience that let Vanta'ns do their best work as we grow quickly across the globe. Internal comms sits at the heart of that mission: making sure every Vanta'n understands our strategy, our story, and what's expected of them, no matter how fast we're moving.

Reporting to the Head of People, this is a build-from-scratch mandate. You'll define the strategy, the infrastructure, and the cadence for how Vanta communicates. You'll have room to bring your own voice and instincts into how we do it, from the words we choose for a key company moment to how an all-hands actually feels in the room. Then you'll roll up your sleeves to make it happen.

What you’ll do as an Internal Communications Director at Vanta:

  • Shape how Vanta tells its own story internally and ensure that key messages land at exactly the right moment.

  • Build and manage internal comms infrastructure: the channels, cadences and best practices for how the company communicates (Slack norms, docs, wikis, etc.).

  • Own key internal company-wide moments end to end, including all-hands, major announcements, and org-wide notifications, from planning through delivery.

  • Partner closely with the People team as a strategic sounding board on sensitive or high-stakes communications

  • Serve as a strategic communications partner across the business, triaging and prioritizing company-wide communication requests and partnering with stakeholders to translate complex topics into clear, effective messaging.

  • Partner with Marketing and External Comms to keep our internal and external narrative aligned and consistent.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the C-team and Leadership Team on how and when to communicate major business updates.

  • Build and protect company culture and morale through comms, keeping the energy and momentum visible as Vanta grows.

  • Evolve Vanta's internal comms strategy and toolkit as the company scales, experimenting with new formats and channels.

  • Measure and iterate on what's working, bringing a data-informed lens to internal comms.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8-10+ years of experience building and running an internal comms strategy, ideally at a high-growth company.

  • Proven track record on building an internal comms strategy and executing on that strategy

  • Strong writer and storyteller who can translate complex or sensitive topics into clear, human messaging.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Data and Analytics team is currently looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join us!

You’ll be responsible for laying the foundation for a best-in-class business analytics function. You’ll partner closely with our business stakeholders to ensure that our analytics stack and processes meet the business needs today with an eye towards the future.

What you’ll do as a Senior Data Scientist at Vanta:

  • Build and maintain trusted product data assets using dbt, Snowflake, and modern analytics infrastructure

  • Leverage AI-powered analytics tools and data agents (e.g., Snowflake Cortex) to accelerate insight generation, automate repeatable analysis, and scale decision-making

  • Define and evolve measurement frameworks for product health, customer lifecycle, and AI-powered product experiences

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success to influence product strategy through data

  • Help define Vanta’s analytics strategy and AI measurement practices as our product and data platform evolve

  • Lead executive analytics reviews, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations that drive company decisions

How to be successful in this role:

  • 4+ years of experience working with data as a Data Scientist, Product Analyst, or Analytics Engineer in an applied business setting

  • Strong foundation in SQL, Python (or R), statistics, and machine learning

  • Experience designing and evaluating experiments, predictive models, and other statistical analyses to inform product decisions

  • Experience building scalable data assets, metrics, and analytical frameworks on modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, dbt)

  • Deep experience with data visualization

  • Experience using modern AI-assisted analytics tools or LLM-powered workflows to accelerate analysis and improve decision making

  • Deep understanding of product analytics, customer behavior, and B2B SaaS growth metrics

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success throughout the product lifecycle

  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into meaningful analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations

  • Passion for building reusable analytical systems that increase organizational leverage rather than one-off analyses

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Product Platform org - the group that powers product development across Vanta by building the shared foundations that every engineering team builds on top of. This hire will join one of two closely-aligned teams within the org, each working on foundational challenges with company-wide impact.

Application Primitives is responsible for the shared, customer-facing platform components that product teams implement across the product: examples include comments, notifications platform, event log infrastructure, and agentic audit trails. This team sits at the intersection of platform and product - not pure infrastructure, not pure product - building the reusable building blocks that let other teams ship faster and more consistently.

Libraries & Foundations is a brand-new team that owns Vanta's internal engineering libraries and golden-path patterns. Sitting between core platform and product platform in the stack, this team builds the TypeScript-first abstractions and shared foundations that all Vanta engineers build on top of - including event-driven architecture libraries, code quality tooling, and test frameworks.

You'll be evaluated for both teams based on your background and interests, and the decision on team placement will reflect where your skills and passions are the strongest fit.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! 

What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform at Vanta:

  • Design and build high-quality, scalable systems and shared libraries that multiple engineering teams depend on - whether that's shared customer-facing components (Applications Primitives) or internal abstractions (Libraries & Foundations)

  • Partner deeply with product engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into clean, well-documented APIs and services

  • Drive technical decisions and influence architecture across team boundaries, with a focus on developer experience and platform scalability

  • Define and uphold engineering standards for shared components, ensuring consistency, performance, and security across the systems you own

  • Participate actively in code review, design discussions, and technical planning - raising the engineering quality bar for your team and beyond

  • Write and maintain thorough documentation for the systems and libraries you build, enabling engineers across the org to use and contribute to them

  • Contribute to building Vanta's engineering culture as we scale

How to be successful in this role:

  • Industry experience in backend or fullstack software engineering, with a focus on platform, shared infrastructure, or developer-facing systems

  • Experience building shared APIs, services, or platform components used by multiple engineering teams - a platform mindset is critical

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architecture, or message queue systems (Kafka, SQS, pub/sub)

  • Excellent communication skills - able to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and design stakeholders, and to clearly articulate technical trade-offs

  • Track record of shipping high-quality, maintainable code with sound judgment on architectural decisions

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

This team sits at the intersection of platform and product - not pure infrastructure, not pure product - building the reusable building blocks that let other teams ship faster and more consistently.

 

Libraries & Foundations is a brand-new team that owns Vanta's internal engineering libraries and golden-path patterns. Sitting between core platform and product platform in the stack, this team builds the TypeScript-first abstractions and shared foundations that all Vanta engineers build on top of - including event-driven architecture libraries, code quality tooling, and test frameworks.

 

You'll be evaluated for both teams based on your background and interests, and the decision on team placement will reflect where your skills and passions are the strongest fit.

 

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on!

 

What you’ll do as a Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform at Vanta:

  • Design and build high-quality, scalable systems and shared libraries that multiple engineering teams depend on - whether that's shared customer-facing components (Applications Primitives) or internal abstractions (Libraries & Foundations)

  • Partner deeply with product engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into clean, well-documented APIs and services

  • Drive technical decisions and influence architecture across team boundaries, with a focus on developer experience and platform scalability

  • Define and uphold engineering standards for shared components, ensuring consistency, performance, and security across the systems you own

  • Participate actively in code review, design discussions, and technical planning - raising the engineering quality bar for your team and beyond

  • Write and maintain thorough documentation for the systems and libraries you build, enabling engineers across the org to use and contribute to them

  • Contribute to building Vanta's engineering culture as we scale

 

How to be successful in this role:

  • Industry experience in backend or fullstack software engineering, with a focus on platform, shared infrastructure, or developer-facing systems

  • Experience building shared APIs, services, or platform components used by multiple engineering teams - a platform mindset is critical

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architecture, or message queue systems (Kafka, SQS, pub/sub)

  • Excellent communication skills - able to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and design stakeholders, and to clearly articulate technical trade-offs

  • Track record of shipping high-quality, maintainable code with sound judgment on architectural decisions

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

 

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • Pension contribution

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Flexible work hours and location

  • 21 days of Vacation Time and 80 hours of Sick Leave

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

As Vanta continues its push into the enterprise, the Upmarket Account Executive team is at the center of that growth, and this role is the dedicated enablement partner making that motion faster, sharper, and more scalable. As a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager supporting our Upmarket AE organization, you'll operate as a true strategic thought partner to AE leadership, helping design and build the enablement infrastructure needed to win in complex, enterprise sales environments. This is a high-autonomy role that shapes how Vanta's most strategic sellers learn, grow, and perform.

What you’ll do as a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta:

  • Serve as a dedicated strategic partner to Upmarket AE leadership, including directors and frontline managers, to deeply understand the upmarket GTM motion and proactively identify where enablement can drive measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

  • Build and maintain a suite of high-quality enablement resources, including playbooks, deal strategy frameworks, account planning tools, and competitive positioning guides, that equip AEs to engage and win at the enterprise level.

  • Design and deliver enterprise-grade sales methodology programs, such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and embed them into the day-to-day practices of the Upmarket AE team.

  • Conduct continuous needs assessments, drawing on data from Gong, Salesforce, and direct field observation, to identify capability gaps and prioritize the enablement roadmap accordingly.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Product Management, and Solutions Engineering to ensure Upmarket AEs have timely, high-quality content and messaging that reflects Vanta's evolving enterprise positioning.

  • Define, track, and report on enablement effectiveness metrics that connect directly to AE productivity, ramp time, quota attainment, and pipeline health for the upmarket segment.

  • Influence the broader enablement strategy by acting as the voice of the Upmarket AE field, surfacing trends, gaps, and opportunities to enable smarter decisions across the GTM organization.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, or a closely related GTM role, with a strong track record of supporting complex, enterprise sales organizations.

  • Deep expertise in enterprise sales methodologies, with MEDDPICC strongly preferred, and the ability to coach sellers on how to apply them in real deal scenarios.

  • Proven experience partnering directly with senior sales leadership as a strategic advisor, not just a program executor, with the ability to influence and drive alignment across stakeholders.

  • Experience building greenfield or early-stage enablement programs for an upmarket or enterprise segment, including onboarding, skills certification, and ongoing field enablement.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data and field insights to diagnose problems, measure impact, and continuously improve programs.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to deliver high-impact learning experiences and earn credibility with experienced, senior-level sellers.

  • Proficiency with enablement tools and the broader GTM tech stack, including Gong, Salesforce, and content or learning management platforms such as Highspot, Seismic, or Workramp.

  • Build deep trust with Upmarket AE leadership quickly, acting as a true thought partner who is embedded in the business, understands the enterprise sales motion inside and out, and proactively brings solutions, not just programs.

  • Balance strategic thinking with a bias for action. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, designing scalable infrastructure while also rolling up your sleeves to execute when it matters.

  • Use data to tell a story. Connect enablement activity to business outcomes and communicate impact clearly to both field stakeholders and Enablement leadership.

  • Stay close to the field. Spend time listening to calls, sitting in on deal reviews, and building relationships with AEs and FLMs to ensure everything you build is grounded in real-world context.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

  • Identify, develop, and implement new processes in our security operations program

  • Ability to build trust and strong partnerships internally with internal teams toward security goals.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a member of Vanta’s Account Management team, you will be responsible for the expansion and retention of a subset of Vanta’s Customers by developing and maintaining strong relationships with our customers. You will serve as the primary point of contact for all post-sale commercial conversations, including mid-cycle upsells and renewals. As a trusted advisor to the customer, you will deeply understand their business needs and align Vanta’s solutions with their objectives to help mature our customers’ compliance and security programs.

The goal of this team is to achieve overall net revenue expansion of the Vanta customer base, as measured by Net Revenue Retention. They will ensure customers’ security and compliance goals are aligned to their company growth needs and with Vanta’s solutions.

This role will be based in our London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager [EMEA] at Vanta:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with assigned accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Vanta’s current product offerings and take initiative to learn Vanta’s product roadmap to speak confidently when addressing customers.

  • Maintain strong partnerships and alignment with CSMs to understand customer health, ensure close strategic collaboration and execute harmonious communication to accounts.

  • Collaborate on account plans that identify new opportunities for expansion with current customers to increase their usage of Vanta’s platform via new frameworks, security tools, etc.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle of any expansion or renewal opportunity from first meeting to close, negotiating where necessary and pulling in additional internal resources where appropriate (solutions consultants, subject matter experts, etc).

  • Accurately forecast monthly expansion and churn, and maintain a clean SFDC instance with scrupulous pipeline hygiene.

  • Keep a relentless focus on the customer needs and provide a consultative approach in architecting a solution.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 3+ years experience selling to or managing customers

  • Fluency in written and spoken English, with a second European language preferred

  • Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday)

  • Strong ability to prospect and build pipeline without assistance from BDR and/or inbound support

  • Exceptional communication skills (written, verbal, visual), both for internal audiences and customer-facing messaging

  • Be highly motivated with a sense of urgency and willingness to adjust

  • Able to effectively collaborate with a wide range of departments including CS, Marketing, Enablement, and Support

  • Previous experience in security and compliance is not required, but highly desirable

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.
