At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Customers increasingly use AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and internal Slack agents to run their business processes, and security and compliance work is no exception. For those agents to do that work, they need access to Vanta’s trust graph and intelligence layer. Vanta is building for that world: security and compliance products that customers can use through Vanta, through third-party agent platforms, and inside their own internal tools.

As Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem, you will own Vanta’s external agent surfaces: MCP, CLI, and plugins in marketplaces like Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT. Your job is to make Vanta the trusted compliance layer that agents rely on. You will define the strategy, ship the products, and own the outcomes.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Vanta’s agent ecosystem products.

  • Define how agents discover, access, and safely use Vanta capabilities, partnering with the platform teams that own APIs and authentication.

  • Hold outcome parity as a product principle: work a customer can complete in Vanta should be possible through MCP, CLI, and plugin surfaces too.

  • Lead marketplace and plugin launches, aligning product, engineering, legal, security, and go-to-market around each one.

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship secure, reliable developer products.

  • Build the developer-facing marketing motion: external agent documentation and customer stories that show what MCP and CLI users have unlocked.

  • Partner with the product partnerships and alliances team on co-marketing with agent platforms like Anthropic and OpenAI, keeping a pulse on the agent ecosystem so Vanta is part of the key stacks.

  • Define adoption and quality metrics, and use customer and product data to prioritize.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, taking products from strategy through to shipped outcomes.

  • Experience shipping developer-facing or programmatic products (APIs, integrations, plugins, SDKs, or CLI tools), and comfort treating MCP, CLI, and plugins as product surfaces.

  • Technical fluency with APIs, authentication, and developer tools. Hands-on experience building with AI and agent tools, not just evaluating them.

  • Experience taking complex products or partnerships from strategy through launch.

  • Ability to connect ecosystem opportunities to customer problems and product outcomes.

  • Experience building relationships with technology platforms, AI companies, developer communities, or enterprise customers.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work across product, engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and go-to-market.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, and sound judgment in ambiguous environments.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. As a Staff Product Manager, AI Foundations at Vanta, you will build the core AI capabilities that power Vanta’s AI product experiences: the agent harness our agents are built on, and the quality and evaluation stack that makes them trustworthy.

The AI pillar is making Vanta the intelligence layer for security and compliance work, wherever that work starts. We build the AI products and foundations that work across Vanta: a cohesive first-party Vanta Agent experience, headless surfaces like MCP and CLI that bring Vanta into tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the shared capabilities that let every team ship high-trust AI products.

This role sits behind Vanta’s customer-facing AI experiences. Today, every team shipping AI features has to answer the same hard questions on their own: how to define quality, how to evaluate it, and how to know a change is safe to ship. You will turn those answers into shared foundations, so the AI experiences our customers rely on get better and more trustworthy over time.

What you’ll do as a Staff Product Manager, AI Foundations at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Vanta’s core AI capabilities: the agent harness and the AI quality and evaluation stack

  • Live in agent traces to build intuition for how customers actually use our AI products, and turn that into the highest-leverage improvements

  • Make Vanta’s AI products win on quality: build golden datasets, automated evaluators aligned to expert judgment, and self-serve tooling so PMs, subject-matter experts, and designers can run evals without an engineer in the loop

  • Scale the agent harness: shape the core capabilities Vanta’s agents are built on, making clear tradeoffs across cost, latency, reliability, and safety

  • Set the quality bar teams adopt for evals, launch readiness, and observability, and drive adoption without becoming a gatekeeper

  • Partner closely with EPD teams across Vanta, and with the AI pillar’s other teams, to turn proven patterns into shared capabilities

  • Help define and shape Vanta’s product team culture as we grow

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 8+ years of product management experience, including platform, infrastructure, or technically deep products

  • Have hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents, and understand how evals, observability, and quality signals drive systematic improvement in AI products

  • Bring strong user empathy: you get close to customer problems and bring that clarity back to the team

  • Know how to run foundational products like a product, with adoption goals, feedback loops, and prioritization grounded in what your users need

  • Earn credibility with senior engineers and hold your own in deeply technical design discussions

  • Use coding agents daily, and stay deeply curious about where models and agent tooling are going

  • Think in systems: you can reason about how evaluation, observability, and infrastructure choices compound across many teams and customer experiences

  • Thrive in ambiguity in a fast-moving AI space, leading with the problem and the process rather than a fixed answer

  • Communicate with clarity and influence, both written and verbal, with team members, stakeholders, and executives

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Family planning benefits

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta for Government (V4G) is how we bring that mission to the public sector. As federal compliance undergoes its biggest shift in a decade — FedRAMP 20x, machine-readable authorization, OSCAL — we're building the platform that turns federal frameworks into automated, continuously monitored product experiences. The GRC Subject Matter Experts on this team are the people who make that possible.

As Vanta's GRC Subject Matter Expert for V4G, you'll own federal compliance content used by every customer pursuing or maintaining federal authorization on our platform. This is an interpretation-and-authoring role, not a compliance program administration role: your job is to interpret underlying control requirements, identify where FedRAMP modifies or constrains the NIST framework, and translate those interpretations into precise, technically testable guidance that engineering can build and customers can act on. The content you write ships as product — a five-person startup and a Fortune 100 CSP both receive it — so calibrating depth, precision, and universality is the core craft.

You'll join Vanta's Security organization, which directly influences product development, facilitates the creation of automated GRC solutions for customers, and provides expert advisory services across the company.

What you’ll do as a V4G GRC SME at Vanta:

  • Build and own federal compliance frameworks — Lead the creation, enhancement, and lifecycle management of controls, evidence requirements, and implementation guidance for FedRAMP (Low/Moderate/High), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, DFARS, and StateRAMP. Author clear control rationales, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing guidance shipped as out-of-the-box product content.

  • Interpret controls at the mechanics level — Work fluently with 800-53A assessment procedures and 800-53B baselines; resolve organization-defined parameters and FedRAMP's constraints on them; decompose controls into distinct technical obligations; correctly resolve inherited, shared, and customer-owned responsibilities within a customer responsibility matrix; and anchor evidence expectations in authoritative artifacts (PPSM, STIG and CIS hardening standards and their scan outputs across operating systems, databases, network devices, and endpoints).

  • Author automated tests & continuous monitoring — Translate controls and infrastructure context (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP, SaaS, endpoints, CI/CD) into spec-level automated tests and detectors. Define test logic, data sources, edge cases, and — critically — failure conditions: how unapproved items, exceptions, missing data, and unevaluated resources affect a result. Pair with Engineering to implement and maintain detectors with versioned framework mappings.

  • Lead V4G's machine-readable future — Shape how Vanta's federal content is architected for OSCAL and FedRAMP 20x: machine-readable SSPs, config-as-compliance, and continuous authorization workflows.

  • Design crosswalks and mappings — Maintain bidirectional crosswalks across federal frameworks (800-53 ↔ 800-171 ↔ CMMC ↔ StateRAMP) with canonical control IDs, mapping confidence, and traceability to source authority.

  • Act as a product advisor across discovery & design — Partner with the V4G PM and Design on feature discovery, review UI/UX for control, evidence, and authorization workflows, and author PRDs and acceptance criteria grounded in agency, auditor, and 3PAO needs.

  • Enable AI-assisted compliance — Partner with Engineering/ML to design LLM-powered guidance and automation for federal workflows. Translate SME knowledge into machine-readable specs, define gold-standard evaluation sets, and implement quality and safety guardrails.

  • Synthesize feedback loops — Analyze input from customers, agencies, 3PAOs, and internal teams to identify content gaps and ship iterative updates quickly and safely.

  • Raise the bar — Mentor and calibrate other SMEs, set content quality standards for the federal portfolio, and set framework strategy that others execute against.

How to be successful in this role:

  • Experience — 8–10+ years in GRC and/or Information Security with hands-on federal compliance work: building or maintaining FedRAMP programs on the CSP side, authoring SSPs and supporting artifacts, and running continuous monitoring. DoD impact-level (IL4/IL5) or CMMC experience is a strong plus. Note: this is a builder role — candidates whose federal experience is primarily assessment (3PAO) or compliance program coordination will find the day-to-day is materially different from that work.

  • Federal interpretation depth — Demonstrated fluency with the NIST 800-53/FedRAMP relationship, 800-53A/B, organization-defined parameters, control inheritance vs. non-applicability, customer responsibility matrices, PPSM, and STIG/CIS benchmarks.

  • OSCAL & FedRAMP 20x — Working familiarity with OSCAL or other machine-readable compliance approaches, and an informed point of view on where federal authorization is heading.

  • Test-design rigor — Ability to turn a control into a functional test with defined pass and failure conditions, evidence sufficiency criteria, and coverage across relevant system components.

  • Product mindset — Ability to translate requirements into productizable capabilities usable by organizations of every size; comfort with experimentation and data-driven prioritization.

  • Technical & automation (AI-augmented) — Active, current use of AI in GRC work: AI pair-programming tools to accelerate specs, mappings, and test logic; lightweight automations across Sheets/Airtable, APIs, and webhooks; AI-augmented workflows (LLM-assisted control guidance, cross-framework mapping, evidence triage) with measured outcomes; and safe-use patterns for prompts and agents.

  • Analytical & detail-oriented — Precise control wording, mapping accuracy, and evidence specificity; comfortable in spreadsheets and large datasets.

  • Communication & collaboration — Excellent written and verbal skills; effective with engineers, designers, GTM teams, agencies, 3PAOs, and customers.

  • Self-motivated and independent — Operates autonomously at Lead level, setting direction rather than awaiting it.

  • Nice-to-have — StateRAMP, CNSSI 1253/ICD 503, GovCloud or IL-environment architecture experience, or prior product/content roles at a GRC platform.

  • Certifications (preferred, not required) — One or more of: CISSP-ISSEP, CISA, FedRAMP 3PAO assessor credentials (CCP/CCA), CISM, or equivalent experience.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • 11 company-paid holidays

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

You will build the layer that makes Vanta's data actually useful: a single interpretive layer that reads across every source of truth and makes them queryable, reasoned-over, and genuinely illuminating — for EPD, for GTM, and for anyone in the org trying to understand what's happening and why.

The EPD Systems team is building the infrastructure Vanta's engineering, product, and design organization depends on to understand itself. We're constructing three interlocking layers: sources of truth at the foundation, an operating system that makes delivery legible, and the intelligence layer that reasons across all of it. This role owns the intelligence layer — the one that doesn't exist yet.

This is a builder role. You will ship working things yourself — prototypes, internal tools, agent workflows. You will not hand specs to someone else and wait. Communication isn't a separate deliverable; it's how you learn what to build.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Builder at Vanta:

  • Build the intelligence layer: a cross-source interpretive layer that reads across Vanta's sources of truth and makes them queryable and reasoned-over by EPD leadership, GTM, and beyond

  • Define what to build: scope the problem yourself, make explicit tradeoffs about what to defer, and own the sequence of what gets built and when

  • Ship working things yourself: prototypes, internal tools, agent workflows — using AI as part of how you work, not what you report on

  • Understand the organization: go to the teams whose decisions this layer will serve — GTM, G&A, EPD — and come back knowing what they can't answer today

  • Catch and address AI-specific quality problems — reliability, cost, latency, drift, bad answers — before they cause damage

  • Build on top of what the Signal Collection and EPD OS roles are constructing; understand what's trustworthy and what's coming

How to be successful in this role:

  • You scope ambiguous problems yourself — you don't wait for the mandate to sharpen before you start. You're comfortable showing unpolished work, and you're honest about when to push ahead alone vs. pull in an engineer

  • You've shipped real things with LLM tooling recently, and your approach has changed in the last six months. If someone described AI architecture to you and their thinking hadn't evolved since last year, that would tell you something

  • You change behavior across orgs you don't control — GTM, G&A — through what you build and how you communicate, not through authority

  • You know what quality means when building with AI: reliability, cost, latency, edge cases, drift. You've caught a real quality problem before it caused damage, and you stayed with it after it was technically "shipped"

  • You find root causes rather than symptoms, and you think through second- and third-order effects before you make a change

  • We use AI to augment our own capabilities and invest deeply in helping every Vantan enhance their work through AI

  • No CS degree required, no pedigree gate. Real, recent, shipped work and the ability to learn fast are what clear our bar

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta is growing fast—we’re profitable, consistently exceeding our growth targets, and maintaining exceptionally strong NPS scores along the way. Our momentum is driven by a clear mission: to secure the internet and help startups scale with trust. As the category leader in compliance and security automation, we’re capturing market share rapidly, and our Sales team is at the forefront of that charge.

 

To support this continued growth, we’re expanding our Early Stage Sales team. We’re looking for high-energy, customer-focused French speaking Account Executive who thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the challenge of turning velocity into results. In this role, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle—from first touch to close—and play a critical role in positioning Vanta as the go-to solution for early-stage companies navigating security and compliance for the first time.

 

This is a highly transactional, new business role where success comes from running a tight, repeatable process and maintaining a high daily output.

 

If you love the energy of working with startups, are driven to outperform targets, and want to make a tangible impact in a rapidly scaling business, we’d love to hear from you.

 

This role will be based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

 

What you’ll do as an Account Executive, Early Stage - EMEA at Vanta:

  • Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta.

  • Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on speed and efficiency, aiming to close deals within a 30-day timeframe.

  • Turn our inbound demand into closed-won business quickly and consistently, working across a large number of prospects

  • Operate in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment, running a high number of discovery calls and managing a broad pipeline of opportunities simultaneously.

  • Continuously optimize your sales workflow to maintain high activity levels, improve conversion, and deliver repeatable results.

  • Define and communicate the value of Vanta to prospects, including tailoring sales materials and demos to resonate with early-stage startup buyers

  • Surface product feedback and trends from prospects to inform go-to-market and product development strategies.

     

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 12+ months in a closing and quota-carrying role, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally focused on SMB or early-stage startups, where short deal cycles and high activity are the norm

  • Thrive in high-velocity sales environments and are energized by repetition, fast decision-making, and a transactional approach to deal flow

  • Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects.

  • Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up.

  • You’re intrinsically motivated, proactive, and resourceful—comfortable taking initiative without needing direction

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

     

What you can expect as a Vanta'n in Ireland:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

You will own the data Vanta's EPD organization actually runs on — bringing new signal sources online, standardizing them at the point of ingestion, and building the systems that make the underlying data trustworthy rather than merely stored.

The EPD Systems team is building the infrastructure Vanta's engineering, product, and design organization depends on to understand itself. Not by asking teams to be more diligent but by going to the source, processing it, standardizing it, and pushing value back out so each source of truth earns its own adoption.

What you’ll do as a Operations Manager, Signal Systems at Vanta:

  • Bring new signal sources online end to end — from discovery and scoping through ingestion, standardization, and live operation

  • Identify the specific failure modes in each information source and build systems that mitigate them at the point of ingestion

  • Go to the teams that produce and consume a signal, understand what the information actually means and what they need back from it, and build accordingly

  • Replace human-diligence dependencies with engineering solutions: derive fields, pull from source systems, validate at write time

  • Build alongside teammates who are growing into building — raise their technical ceiling, not just your own output

  • Partner with the inference and systems layers to ensure what you produce is queryable, trustworthy, and ready to build on

How to be successful in this role:

  • You look at a data source and see its failure modes before its contents: where it lies, where it goes stale, where it's duplicated, where the schema won't hold at 10x

  • Your first move on an adherence problem is an engineering answer — derive it, pull it, or validate it at write time. Better forms and nudges are your last resort

  • You've shipped something yourself in roughly the last 12–18 months — a pipeline, an internal tool, a working prototype, an agent — and you can walk through the code and defend your choices. Specs handed to an engineer don't count for this bar

  • You've built something real with Claude, an LLM API, or agentic tooling — not "I use ChatGPT for drafts." You'll be asked what broke and how you worked around it

  • You build alongside people: some teammates do program-delivery work today and should grow into building; you see growing their capability as part of your mandate, not a tax on it

  • You go find out what the data means by talking to the people who produce and consume it, and you come back with a changed understanding — not a requirements list

  • We use AI to augment our own capabilities and invest deeply in helping every Vantan enhance their work through AI

  • No CS degree or formal engineering tenure required. Shipping real things fast with AI-assisted tooling clears our bar

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Customer expansion is one of Vanta's highest-priority growth levers, and this role sits at the center of it. As the Revenue Enablement Manager supporting Account Management, you'll operate as a strategic thought partner to AM leadership and the broader Revenue organization — designing and leading the programs that make Account Managers more effective, equip them to drive expansion, and help them operate as a unified front with the Account Executive team. This is a high-autonomy role that connects data, business priorities, and cross-functional expertise to directly influence AM performance and expansion outcomes, and you'll be the architect of a consistent, repeatable expansion motion that defines how Vanta shows up across the full customer lifecycle.

What you’ll do as a Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta:

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of Global Account Management and AM leaders, building a deep understanding of the global AM business and proactively identifying where enablement can drive measurable impact.

  • Independently identify performance trends, capability gaps, and organizational priorities by combining data analysis with field insights and stakeholder input, conducting ongoing needs assessments with AM and AE leadership to surface whitespace opportunities and prioritize enablement investments.

  • Shape and maintain the AM enablement strategy and roadmap — including playbooks, skill-based training, and certifications — in alignment with the broader Revenue organization's priorities, accelerating account growth and improving net revenue retention (NRR).

  • Design, launch, and measure strategic enablement programs that improve Account Manager performance and increase pipeline generation for expansion.

  • Build programs that establish a consistent, cohesive sales motion between Account Executives and Account Managers, ensuring a seamless, high-quality customer experience from new logo through expansion.

  • Drive adoption of sales processes and reinforce consistent execution across the global AM organization.

  • Partner with Product Enablement, Product Marketing, and GTM Enablement peers to ensure AMs have current messaging, competitive intelligence, and product knowledge that supports customer growth conversations.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives from opportunity identification through program design, stakeholder alignment, execution, and measurement.

  • Deliver relevant, high-impact AM enablement sessions, including launching initial programs within the first 90 days.

  • Influence the broader enablement strategy by surfacing trends, gaps, and opportunities that help Vanta make smarter decisions across the Revenue organization.

  • Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to track enablement effectiveness, reporting on both leading and lagging indicators to continuously iterate and improve program impact and adoption.

  • Use AI and technology to improve the effectiveness, reach, and scalability of enablement programs.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 4+ years of experience in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement, or a GTM-focused role supporting an Account Management or Post-Sales organization or expansion selling motions.

  • Strong understanding of the AM or Post-Sales business, including customer needs, expansion motions, and the performance drivers of successful Account Managers.

  • Proven track record leading programs from identifying a need through designing, launching, and measuring an initiative, with demonstrated results driving measurable improvements in NRR, pipeline generation, or account growth.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to dig into data, identify trends, diagnose performance gaps, and turn insights into practical enablement recommendations; comfortable using tools like Gong, Highspot, Seismic, and CRM reporting to inform program design.

  • Strong working knowledge of B2B SaaS sales methodologies — such as Command of the Message and MEDDPICC — and know how to apply them across both new logo and post-sale contexts.

  • Proven experience partnering with senior and executive stakeholders as well as frontline managers and cross-functional peers (AE, AM, PMM, Rev Ops), building alignment around priorities, influencing decisions without direct authority, and quickly earning credibility as a trusted thought partner across a complex organization.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it does not yet exist, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action and resilience — thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments and energized by building something from the ground up.

  • Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse audiences — from frontline reps to senior leadership — and deliver engaging enablement experiences for a global AM audience.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship..

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

You will build the operating system for EPD — the systems, agents, and practices that make engineering, product, and design unreasonably effective at delivery, with Jira as the substrate.

The EPD Systems team is building the infrastructure Vanta's engineering, product, and design organization depends on to understand itself and operate well. We're constructing three interlocking layers: sources of truth at the foundation, a shared interpretive layer that reasons across all of them, and the operating system that makes the work itself legible. This role owns the operating system.

This is not a traditional PMO or status-reporting role. You build — agents, automation, workflow design, and the practices that make teams want to use the system rather than route around it.

What you’ll do as a Senior Systems Designer at Vanta:

  • Design and own workflow and hierarchy across engineering, product, and design in Jira

  • Make sure Jira reflects real practice, and real practice reflects what needs to show up in Jira — in both directions

  • Build the agents and automation that run the system yourself, with AI as part of how you work

  • Drive adoption: go to the teams whose practice doesn't match the substrate today and change that — through conversation, well-built artifacts, or clear instruction that works without you in the room

  • Understand delivery breakdowns at the mechanism level and build fixes that address the root cause, not the symptom

  • Build alongside teammates who are growing into more technical work — raise their ceiling, not just your own output

How to be successful in this role:

  • You build and ship, recently, with AI as part of how you work. "I'd ask an engineer to build that" is not a valid answer here

  • You find the mechanism that's actually failing before you reach for a tool. Your default is to remove steps, not add them

  • You move toward a solution now. You don't wait for a green light to start, and you can name a real decision you made and acted on without checking first

  • You learn what's new before anyone tells you to — especially in AI tooling — and you share what you find with others

  • You get things adopted without authority: through a conversation, a well-built artifact, or clear instruction that carries your message beyond you being in the room

  • You're accountable for the outcome, not just the artifact. The real work often happens after launch — adoption, fixing wrong assumptions, cleanup after handoff — and you do that work yourself

  • We use AI to augment our own capabilities and invest deeply in helping every Vantan enhance their work through AI

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Senior Software Engineers independently drive complex technical work, shape the systems and technical decisions within their teams, and enable other engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.

Vanta's product monitors the security posture of thousands of companies, pulling tens of millions of API calls of data per day, pushing information from hundreds of thousands of laptop agents, and running tests against that data continuously to identify potential security threats. Our infrastructure and tooling need to stay ahead of exponential growth in our customer base. As a Senior Software Engineer at Vanta, you'll drive complex projects across our technical stack, contribute to the technical direction of your team, and mentor other engineers. Your past experience will be leveraged to enable and accelerate Vanta's growth.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on! 

Tests are at the heart of how Vanta continuously monitors security and compliance for our customers. The Evaluation Engine team builds the runtime platform that powers these checks. We own how Tests are scheduled and executed, how their results are persisted and exposed, and the systems that keep this runtime reliable as Vanta grows.

In this role, you'll work on some of the core systems behind Vanta's Tests platform. You'll tackle problems around the reliability, correctness, and performance of Test execution, evolve the systems and abstractions that allow the platform to scale, and make it easier for other engineering teams to build on the Tests runtime. Many of these problems span multiple systems and teams and require a deep understanding of how the platform behaves in production.

  • Own complex projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and operation

  • Design and evolve the backend systems, APIs, and data models used to run Tests and process their results

  • Improve the reliability, correctness, performance, and observability of the Tests runtime

  • Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and build durable solutions

  • Simplify existing systems and improve the abstractions and interfaces that other engineers build on

  • Collaborate with engineers across Vanta on problems that span systems and tea

  • Give thoughtful feedback in design and code reviews, communicate technical tradeoffs, and help other engineers make good decisions

  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to the engineering culture of the team

  • Have independently delivered complex technical projects where the problem or solution was not always well defined

  • Have strong systems thinking and fundamentals in backend system design, APIs, and data modeling

  • Be a strong debugger who can reason about correctness, reliability, performance, and scalability across complex systems

  • Make effective technical tradeoffs, take ownership of systems in production, and improve mature systems incrementally

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly, give thoughtful feedback on designs, and collaborate effectively with engineers across teams

  • Experience with TypeScript, GraphQL, MongoDB, and observability tools such as Datadog is a plus

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Automation - Foundations team, you will lead the re-platforming of the data layer underneath Vanta’s entire compliance product.

Foundations ingests tens of thousands of security and compliance resources per second from across our customer’s environments. We store the data, catalog it, make it queryable, and turn it into evidence that has to survive a real SOC 2 or FedRAMP audit.

We are in the middle of moving our platform from a monolithic Mongo-centric architecture to a Kafka data pipeline that decouples data fetching from processing and is backed by Postgres and S3. Our biggest challenges are around supporting this migration at scale in a domain that requires correctness and while supporting an evolving set of requirements for upcoming products.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on.

What you'll do as a Staff Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Lead the migration of Vanta’s resource data model from a Mongo-centric solution to a schema-aware Postgres-backed solution and running both generations in parallel without breaking a customer integration.

  • Drive solutions across teams that you do not own but are dependent on the platform built by your team.

  • Design for correctness under eventual consistency with idempotent session handling, conditional writes that survive out-of-order delivery, reconciliation rather than strict cross-service validation, and explicitly backpressure instead of implicit database limits.

  • Design and evolve Vanta's data ingestion and pipeline architecture, ensuring reliable, high-throughput processing of terabyte-scale data streams across distributed systems

  • Take our Query API from internal use to a production platform with schema versioning, joins and exports, per-tenant isolation, and predictable latency under load.

  • Build data infrastructure where correctness is externally auditable as the evidence Vanta produces has to hold up in front of an auditor.

  • Diagnose the failures that only appear at production data shapes and can include hot partitions, unbounded fan-out, and online rewrites of continuously-written tables.

  • Set architectural direction for streaming infrastructure (Kafka and event queuing), caching layers (Redis), and persistent storage (Postgres, MongoDB) across the Foundations stack

  • Mentor senior engineers across the team, raising the technical bar through design reviews, architectural guidance, and hands-on contributions to the most complex systems challenges

  • Champion engineering excellence in reliability, observability, and operational hygiene across the data infrastructure that powers Vanta's core product

  • Leverage AI tools and systems to accelerate your own work and explore how they can improve the systems you build

How to be successful in this role:

  • Proven track record leading platform migration initiatives (v1→v2 architecture transitions) while maintaining backward compatibility and system availability

  • Strong command of streaming and queuing infrastructure (Kafka or equivalent), including partitioning strategy, consumer group semantics, redelivery, and idempotency.

  • Deep industry experience in distributed systems and data pipeline engineering, with demonstrated experience designing and operating systems at enterprise scale (terabyte-scale ingestion, high-throughput event processing)

  • Fluency in both relational and document data modeling at scale (Postgres and MongoDB), including query planning, connection pooling, and online schema change on large, continuously written tables.

  • Experience collaborating with engineering leadership to define multi-quarter technical roadmaps and drive them through to delivery

  • Solid AWS fundamentals and comfort operating in TypeScript and Node.

  • Able to articulate complex systems tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences and bring cross-functional partners along on long-horizon technical decisions

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC offices

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team-building activities, lunch-and-learns, and other company-wide events!

CAN","department":"Software Engineering","team":"Software Engineering","employmentType":"FullTime","location":"Remote - Canada","shouldDisplayCompensationOnJobPostings":false,"secondaryLocations":[],"publishedAt":"2026-08-24T22:55:01.363+00:00","isListed":true,"isRemote":true,"workplaceType":"Remote","address":{"postalAddress":{"addressRegion":"Ontario","addressCountry":"Canada","addressLocality":"Toronto"}},"jobUrl":"https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/vanta/a59302dc-b7ea-4bba-af3c-ddab91489848","applyUrl":"https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/vanta/a59302dc-b7ea-4bba-af3c-ddab91489848/application","descriptionHtml":"

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Automation - Foundations team, you will lead the re-platforming of the data layer underneath Vanta’s entire compliance product.

Foundations ingests tens of thousands of security and compliance resources per second from across our customer’s environments. We store the data, catalog it, make it queryable, and turn it into evidence that has to survive a real SOC 2 or FedRAMP audit.

We are in the middle of moving our platform from a monolithic Mongo-centric architecture to a Kafka data pipeline that decouples data fetching from processing and is backed by Postgres and S3. Our biggest challenges are around supporting this migration at scale in a domain that requires correctness and while supporting an evolving set of requirements for upcoming products.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog to learn more about what our team is working on.

What you'll do as a Staff Software Engineer at Vanta:

  • Lead the migration of Vanta’s resource data model from a Mongo-centric solution to a schema-aware Postgres-backed solution and running both generations in parallel without breaking a customer integration.

  • Drive solutions across teams that you do not own but are dependent on the platform built by your team.

  • Design for correctness under eventual consistency with idempotent session handling, conditional writes that survive out-of-order delivery, reconciliation rather than strict cross-service validation, and explicitly backpressure instead of implicit database limits.

  • Design and evolve Vanta's data ingestion and pipeline architecture, ensuring reliable, high-throughput processing of terabyte-scale data streams across distributed systems

  • Take our Query API from internal use to a production platform with schema versioning, joins and exports, per-tenant isolation, and predictable latency under load.

  • Build data infrastructure where correctness is externally auditable as the evidence Vanta produces has to hold up in front of an auditor.

  • Diagnose the failures that only appear at production data shapes and can include hot partitions, unbounded fan-out, and online rewrites of continuously-written tables.

  • Set architectural direction for streaming infrastructure (Kafka and event queuing), caching layers (Redis), and persistent storage (Postgres, MongoDB) across the Foundations stack

  • Mentor senior engineers across the team, raising the technical bar through design reviews, architectural guidance, and hands-on contributions to the most complex systems challenges

  • Champion engineering excellence in reliability, observability, and operational hygiene across the data infrastructure that powers Vanta's core product

  • Leverage AI tools and systems to accelerate your own work and explore how they can improve the systems you build

How to be successful in this role:

  • Proven track record leading platform migration initiatives (v1→v2 architecture transitions) while maintaining backward compatibility and system availability

  • Strong command of streaming and queuing infrastructure (Kafka or equivalent), including partitioning strategy, consumer group semantics, redelivery, and idempotency.

  • Deep industry experience in distributed systems and data pipeline engineering, with demonstrated experience designing and operating systems at enterprise scale (terabyte-scale ingestion, high-throughput event processing)

  • Fluency in both relational and document data modeling at scale (Postgres and MongoDB), including query planning, connection pooling, and online schema change on large, continuously written tables.

  • Experience collaborating with engineering leadership to define multi-quarter technical roadmaps and drive them through to delivery

  • Solid AWS fundamentals and comfort operating in TypeScript and Node.

  • Able to articulate complex systems tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences and bring cross-functional partners along on long-horizon technical decisions

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

  • What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

    • Industry-competitive salary and equity

    • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

    • Pension contribution

    • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

    • Health & wellness stipend

    • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

    • Flexible work hours and location

    • 21 days of Vacation Time and 80 hours of Sick Leave

    • 11 company-paid holidays

    • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

    • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.

As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.

 
 

What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:

  • Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

  • Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

  • Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.

  • Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.

  • Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.

  • Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.

  • Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.

  • Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.

  • Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.

  • Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.

  • Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.

  • Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.

  • Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.

  • Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.

  • Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • 4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.

  • A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.

  • Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.

  • A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.

  • Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.

  • Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

  • Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.

  • A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.

As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:

  • Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

  • Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

  • Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

  • Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

  • Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

  • Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy

  • Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

  • Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

  • Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS

  • Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience

  • Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users

  • Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others

  • Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The Design Systems team creates the visual and interaction foundations that help Vanta deliver coherent, accessible, and high-quality experiences across the product. This team partners across the EPD organization to build the systems, patterns, and practices that enable product teams to move faster while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability.

As a Staff Visual Product Designer focused on Design Systems at Vanta, you will shape the visual language of our product and the systems that bring it to life. You will define and evolve scalable patterns across our design and engineering ecosystems, partner closely with product designers and engineers, and help create a cohesive experience for customers navigating complex security and compliance workflows. You’ll combine exceptional visual craft with systems thinking, product judgment, and the ability to influence across teams.

What you’ll do as a Staff Visual Product Designer, Design Systems at Vanta:

  • Define and evolve Vanta’s visual design language across product surfaces, creating a cohesive, distinctive, and scalable customer experience.

  • Set a high bar for visual craft across typography, color, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, and interaction details.

  • Partner with Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and Brand teams to translate customer and business needs into effective system-level solutions.

  • Own and evolve foundational design system elements, including design tokens, component visual states, responsive behavior, theming, density, and platform-specific adaptations.

  • Create reusable patterns and guidance that help product teams solve common problems consistently while preserving flexibility for different customer workflows.

  • Design and prototype system components and end-to-end product experiences, using high-fidelity exploration to communicate intent and accelerate alignment.

  • Bring visual clarity and hierarchy to complex, data-rich workflows used by security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure designs are implemented with fidelity, accessibility, performance, and maintainability in mind.

  • Establish principles, standards, and review practices that raise the quality and consistency of product design across Vanta.

  • Advocate for inclusive and accessible visual design, ensuring that color, contrast, typography, motion, and interaction states work for a broad range of users and contexts.

  • Help define how the design system supports emerging product needs, including AI-powered experiences, personalization, automation, and increasingly complex enterprise workflows.

  • Use customer insights, product data, usability feedback, and competitive research to identify opportunities to improve the system and its impact.

  • Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).

  • Facilitate critiques, workshops, and cross-functional reviews that help teams make stronger visual and product decisions.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, compelling narratives, prototypes, and a clear point of view.

  • Mentor product designers and contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, experimentation, and customer obsession.

  • Create documentation, examples, and enablement materials that make the design system easy to understand, adopt, and extend.

  • Define and measure the impact of the design system through adoption, consistency, accessibility, usability, delivery efficiency, and customer outcomes.

  • Represent Design Systems in planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums, helping teams align around a shared vision for the Vanta experience.

  • Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, strengthening design craft, and improving how Vanta approaches visual product quality.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of experience designing digital products, with significant experience in visual product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • Deep expertise in visual design for digital products, including typography, color, composition, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, interaction states, and data visualization.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, thoughtful systems thinking, and the ability to improve product experiences at both the component and end-to-end workflow level.

  • Experience creating, evolving, and scaling product design systems used by multiple teams across a growing organization.

  • Strong understanding of design tokens, component architecture, responsive design, accessibility, and the relationship between design tools and front-end implementation.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous product and customer problems into clear, elegant, and reusable visual solutions.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineers to bring detailed visual designs to life and to make pragmatic decisions when implementation constraints arise.

  • Strong product thinking, with the ability to understand customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and the broader relationships among product surfaces and workflows.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience balancing consistency and flexibility, knowing when to use an existing pattern, when to extend it, and when to introduce something new.

  • A demonstrated ability to give and receive thoughtful feedback, mentor others, and raise the quality bar across a design organization.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • Experience designing products in cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

  • Experience with tools such as Figma and familiarity with front-end technologies or design system implementation workflows is a plus.

  • A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how you operate and deliver results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
